description: This file defines the StandaloneSiloHandle class, a component responsible for managing external silo processes for the Orleans testing framework. It includes methods for creating, starting, stopping, and disposing of silo processes, and handles process output/error streams, process lifecycle events, and process configuration.

classes.name: StandaloneSiloHandle
classes.description: A class that manages an external silo process for Orleans testing, providing methods to start, stop, and dispose of the silo process, as well as handling process output and lifecycle events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and start a new silo process given a configuration.

methods.name: CreateDelegate
methods.description: Returns a delegate function to spawn a silo process with a specified executable path.

methods.name: CreateForAssembly
methods.description: Creates a delegate to spawn a silo process from an assembly, adjusting for DLL or executable file.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the silo process asynchronously and sets up output/error data handlers.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo process, optionally gracefully or immediately.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync (overload)
methods.description: Stops the silo process with a provided cancellation token.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the silo handle, stopping the process if active.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the silo handle.
